title: Firestop sealant, through-penetrations
summary: The firestop sealant submittal meets all requirements and can be approved as submitted.

findings.title: VOC (air quality)
findings.detail: Package states 26 g/L; spec requires at most 250 g/L.

findings.title: Test standards
findings.detail: Package states ASTM E814 (UL1479), CAN/ULC-S115, ASTM E1966 (UL2079), ASTM E119 (UL263), ASTM E84 (UL723), ASTM C834, Type C, Grade 0; allowed: astm e814, astm e119, ul 1479.

highlights.quote:
SpecSeal® LCI Sealant is the basis for systems that meet the exacting criteria of ASTM E814 
(UL1479), ASTM E1966 (UL2079) and CAN/ULC-S115 as well as to the time-temperature 
requirements of ASTM E119 (UL263). LCI provides up to a 4-hour fire rating for typical 
service penetrations through concrete or wood floors, concrete or masonry walls, as well as 
gypsum board walls. SpecSeal® LCI Sealant meets Class A finish requirements for Flame 
Spread and Smoke Development when tested in accordance with ASTM E84 (UL723). 
Meets or exceeds the requirements of ASTM C834, Type C, Grade 0.
